title:
This type represents a base {@link MlInterpreter} for interpreting or explaining the outputs of machine learning pipelines
specifically within the context of reliability and risk prediction models.
It is used to provide human-readable insights, explanations, and interpretations of the model results.

The `ReliabilityRiskMl.Pipeline.Interpreter` could be extended by specific interpreters for different machine learning models
that compute reliability risk scores or other risk metrics.
name: ReliabilityRiskMl.Pipeline.Interpreter
